name: Gideon Jura
description: Gideon Jura is a warrior planeswalker raised on Theros, a former bounty hunter who can make himself invulnerable and who founded the Gatewatch.

summary.text: Gideon Jura is a warrior planeswalker raised on Theros, a former bounty hunter who can make himself invulnerable and who founded the Gatewatch.

bio.text: Once a bounty hunter, he saved Fort Keff from the Eldrazi spawn on Zendikar and then went to Ravnica to find an organization of planeswalkers.
Years later, as Eldrazi overran Sea Gate, he went to Ravnica and persuaded Jace to help solve the puzzle of the leylines, then brought him to Zendikar.
The dying Commander Vorik named him Commander-General of the Zendikari, and he rallied the survivors to retake Sea Gate.
He held Ulamog until Jace's hedron trap pulled the titan in, but Ob Nixilis then called up Kozilek and drowned Gideon in muddy water.
After he and the others defeated the demon, he argued that the four could stand together and swore the oath that founded the Gatewatch.

The Gatewatch went on to Kaladesh, where he shielded Chandra on the thopter charge, and to Amonkhet, where he took the name Kytheon Iora from the god Oketra, entered the Trials as her champion and resolved to strike down Bolas.
Bolas pierced his shield and shoulder with a talon and offered him the choice to stay and die or leave and live, and he left, then helped Liliana fight Belzenlok on Dominaria.
In the War of the Spark he vowed to retake Ravnica with the Blackblade, and he attacked Bolas with it, then died when he healed Liliana by taking her death into himself.

status.text: Gideon is dead: he was destroyed in the War of the Spark when he took Liliana's death into himself, and later stories remember him as a fallen friend.

timeline.summary: Gideon, regretting how things ended with Chandra, follows her toward Zendikar, guessing she is chasing the Eye of Ugin from a stolen scroll's map.
timeline.quote: After a short time, he regretted the way things had ended and decided to find her.

timeline.summary: Gideon's tracking of Chandra dead-ends at a barren pass in Akoum.
timeline.quote: Chandra's trail dead-ended at a barren mountain pass in Akoum

timeline.summary: Gideon is admitted into Fort Keff after dark.
timeline.quote: "Welcome to Fort Keff, the safest haven in Akoum."

timeline.summary: Tafre shares his fire and tells Gideon strange stories, then describes waking in a field of flesh and burning yellow dust.
timeline.quote: And then I remember nothing ... until I awoke in a field of flesh.

timeline.summary: Gideon is woken by soldiers beating and netting a surrakar that washed up in Keff.
timeline.quote: Beating it with cudgels until it collapsed, the soldiers threw a weighted net over it as it screeched in an unfamiliar tongue.

timeline.summary: The caged surrakar grips Gideon's arm and warns that the gods are coming, asking to be killed.
timeline.quote: "The gods are coming," it hissed. "Kill me now."

timeline.summary: Refugees pour into Fort Keff, fleeing demon insects, and the captain refuses to heed Gideon's warnings about the surrakar.
timeline.quote: Refugees had been arriving at the already-crowded haven all morning.

timeline.summary: Gideon learns from the surrakar that the gods come from a void without color, time and boundaries and will devour all existence.
timeline.quote: They had been ripped from a void without color, without time, and without boundaries.

timeline.summary: Gideon offers to help defend the fort, and the captain agrees.
timeline.quote: "Now we're speaking the same language."

timeline.summary: A cloud of yellow dust sweeps over Fort Keff, and the Eldrazi spawn arrive at the gates.
timeline.quote: When the worst had past, Gideon struggled to his feet and saw that enemy was already at the gates.

timeline.summary: The creatures crash into the rampart, arrows prove useless, and Gideon draws his sural and leaps into the fray.
timeline.quote: Then he jumped into the fray.

timeline.summary: Gideon draws all the creatures' attention to himself and whirls his sural until the attackers lie dead and Fort Keff is saved.
timeline.quote: Fort Keff had been saved.

timeline.summary: Gideon accepts that he cannot defeat the Titan and believes the surrakar spoke the truth about the Blind Eternities made corporeal.
timeline.quote: This was the chaos of the Blind Eternities made corporeal.

timeline.summary: Gideon orders the surrakar released to lead everyone out along the underground river and to flee.
timeline.quote: "Release the surrakar. He'll lead you out along the underground river. Take everyone and flee!"

timeline.summary: Gideon vows to return and planeswalks to Ravnica to find the planeswalkers' organization.
timeline.quote: Gideon whispered a vow to return and planeswalked away.

timeline.summary: The Magic Origins storyline is announced: five Planeswalkers' emotional awakenings, which ignited their sparks, across ten planes.
timeline.quote: Each of these characters experienced an emotional awakening powerful enough to ignite their spark and change their lives forever.

timeline.summary: The five origin stories are scheduled in order: Chandra, Liliana, Jace, Gideon, Nissa.
timeline.quote: Over the next five weeks, you'll be able to read all five origin stories in this column.

timeline.summary: Gideon kills an Eldrazi monstrosity on Zendikar with a shard of hedron after a hard fight.
timeline.quote: Hedron connected with boney faceplate.

timeline.summary: Munda and his band find Gideon and tell him that Bala Ged has been overrun and destroyed.
timeline.quote: Bala Ged, the entire continent, has be overrun and destroyed.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Gideon and Dars watch Foundry Street burn in a goblin gang war that began with Dargig's murder.
timeline.quote: It was the Shattergang way of declaring war.

timeline.summary: Gideon brings the captured Krenko, stabbed twice in the leg, to the Boros garrison.
timeline.quote: "And I come bearing gifts," said Gideon

timeline.summary: A canister lands in the garrison with a note from the Shattergang Brothers threatening Boros territory unless Krenko is handed over.
timeline.quote: Turn him over to us, or we will reduce Boros territory to rubble.

timeline.summary: Gideon holds a canyon pass against Eldrazi spawn while survivors from Bala Ged escape.
timeline.quote: Gideon planted himself in the narrow path

timeline.summary: A mage collapses the cliffs with lightning along Munda's iron spikes, burying the Eldrazi spawn.
timeline.quote: sheets of white stone tumbled toward the Eldrazi below.

timeline.summary: Munda tells Gideon a great host of Eldrazi descends on Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: "A great host of Eldrazi descends on Sea Gate."

timeline.summary: Gideon storms the Shattergang hideout, fights Rikkig and survives his bomb; Rikkig escapes while Gideon and Dars free prisoners.
timeline.quote: "The Boros didn't take Krenko. I did. Just like I got your brother. And now I'm here for you."

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi overwhelm Sea Gate and pin Gideon under a beam until he frees himself.
timeline.quote: the Eldrazi swept in from both sides of the sea wall.

timeline.summary: Gideon meets the merfolk Jori En carrying her dead companion Kendrin, who had been on the brink of a discovery about leylines and the Eye.
timeline.quote: Kendrin was on the brink of a discovery.

timeline.summary: Gideon concludes Sea Gate is lost and that Kendrin's leylines puzzle is a possible answer, and he needs another expert.
timeline.quote: Fighting to avoid something was not the same as fighting for something.

timeline.summary: Gideon rides an Eldrazi off the sea wall into the sea, then planeswalks to Ravnica.
timeline.quote: In a tangle of tendrils, Gideon fell with it.

timeline.summary: Gideon arrives in Ravnica at the Chamber of the Guildpact, intending to ask Jace for help, and collapses on the steps.
timeline.quote: Gideon ascended the first step, tried for another, but gravity had him, and he collapsed.

timeline.summary: Gideon, bloodied from battle, interrupts dinner and asks Jace for help with Zendikar.
timeline.quote: "Jace Beleren," he said. "I need your help."

timeline.summary: Gideon tells Jace Sea Gate has fallen and asks him to solve the puzzle of leylines.
timeline.quote: "Sea Gate has fallen."

timeline.summary: Jace agrees to help Gideon, insisting he rest first, and takes him to a healer.
timeline.quote: "Fine," Gideon said at last. "Take me to this healer."

timeline.summary: Liliana walks Ravnica's Second District, hearing the Onakke voices and brooding that Jace chose to help Gideon instead of her.
timeline.quote: But he hadn't. Instead, he had agreed to help Gideon.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Jace burst into the chamber as Chandra considers accepting the mantle.
timeline.quote: "It's good to see you, Chandra," said Gideon Jura. "We need your help."

timeline.summary: Gideon and Jace ask Chandra to join them against the Eldrazi, and Jace reminds her of her responsibility for Zendikar's state.
timeline.quote: You have a hand in Zendikar's current state.

timeline.summary: Chandra tells them to go, saying she belongs on Regatha and has made a promise.
timeline.quote: "I belong here. I've made a promise."

timeline.summary: Gideon and Jace planeswalk away, and Chandra walks up the steps toward Mother Luti and the mantle.
timeline.quote: Chandra nodded to Mother Luti, and walked up the steps toward her.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Jace arrive at Vorik's camp and find slaughter and Eldrazi corruption everywhere.
timeline.quote: They stepped into carnage.

timeline.summary: Gideon defends Jace from a pack of Eldrazi spawn and arms him with a sword.
timeline.quote: Gideon leaped between the Eldrazi and Jace.

timeline.summary: Gideon charges through hundreds of Eldrazi to reach a barricade of survivors and gets Jace over the wall.
timeline.quote: Gideon bellowed, "Zendikar!" and charged.

timeline.summary: Jace's telekinesis saves him from Eldrazi spawn.
timeline.quote: knocked back by what must have been a telekinetic blow.

timeline.summary: Gideon learns from a kor soldier that only a few dozen survive under Commander Vorik.
timeline.quote: The woman shook her head. "A few dozen."

timeline.summary: Gideon sends Jace with the soldiers to find Jori En and holds the wall alone.
timeline.quote: look for a merfolk named Jori En.

timeline.summary: Gideon kills a huge Ulamog-like Eldrazi with two heads by punching the smaller head and severing both.
timeline.quote: the Eldrazi fell dead to the ground.

timeline.summary: Gideon collapses the walls of a gap to block the Eldrazi and rejoins the survivors.
timeline.quote: he had created a defensive wall.

timeline.summary: Jace reports that Jori En never reached the camp and may be trapped in Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: He thinks Jori En was among them

timeline.summary: Gideon meets Tazri and the wounded Vorik, who says the survivors have nowhere to run.
timeline.quote: "Yes," Vorik said flatly. "We could have used you."

timeline.summary: Gideon proposes moving the survivors up onto the floating hedrons, and Vorik agrees.
timeline.quote: "Fine," Vorik said. "Lead the way."

timeline.summary: Gideon, Tazri and the kor lead the wounded survivors up ropes onto the hedrons.
timeline.quote: They made the ascent with no complaints, no missteps, and no further injuries.

timeline.summary: Gideon sees Sea Gate's corruption from the hedron and resolves to go look for Jori En, leaving Jace to study the hedrons.
timeline.quote: And I'll find Jori En and bring her back here.

timeline.summary: Jace admits he trusts Gideon, and Gideon climbs down toward Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: "I have to do this," he told himself, gripping the rope.

timeline.summary: A huge Eldrazi lands on the rock and Gideon appears, lashing it away with his sural and hauling everyone up.
timeline.quote: four glowing, white whips fly through the air and lash into the Eldrazi's side.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Jori reunite, and he leads the survivors across floating rocks to a nearby encampment.
timeline.quote: "Jori En!" The Planeswalker cried out

timeline.summary: Nissa tells Gideon her connection to Zendikar was ripped away, but Gideon says his power is unchanged.
timeline.quote: "Mine is gone. It was ripped away.

timeline.summary: Gideon is welcomed at the encampment with the rescued survivors while Nissa reaches out and finds Zendikar silent and empty.
timeline.quote: Zendikar was empty.

timeline.summary: Jace says they must go to the Eye of Ugin; Gideon refuses to leave the encampment and Jace reveals Nissa has left.
timeline.quote: "We already have," said Jace. "Nissa left in the night."

timeline.summary: Jace tells Jori someone must warn Gideon that Ulamog is heading for Sea Gate while he goes on to the Eye alone.
timeline.quote: "Go back and warn them. I'm going to the Eye."

timeline.summary: Gideon and Abeena haul a floating waterfall over Sky Rock to give the survivors fresh water.
timeline.quote: A final yank heaved the waterfall straight over Sky Rock.

timeline.summary: Tazri accuses Gideon of wasting time and of waiting for Jace, and Gideon admits he is not from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: "You're right. I'm not from this world."

timeline.summary: Seble flies Gideon to intercept a flying Eldrazi pursuing a party of refugees, and Gideon kills it after being thrown from the manta.
timeline.quote: he drove the Eldrazi straight into the ground

timeline.summary: Gideon concludes the people cannot survive an evacuation to Zulaport and must stay.
timeline.quote: They had to stay. If they wanted to survive, they had to stay here.

timeline.summary: Gideon argues before the dying Vorik for retaking Sea Gate instead of evacuating to Zulaport.
timeline.quote: "I would have us go back to Sea Gate."

timeline.summary: Vorik names Gideon Commander-General of the Zendikari and tells Tazri to support him.
timeline.quote: You will reclaim Sea Gate, Commander-General Jura.

timeline.summary: Vorik dies, entrusting Zendikar to Gideon.
timeline.quote: "I leave Zendikar to you, Gideon."

timeline.summary: At Vorik's funeral Gideon rallies the survivors to fight back and retake Sea Gate rather than flee.
timeline.quote: We can choose to fight back.

timeline.summary: Tazri pledges to fight beside Gideon, and the crowd cries 'For Zendikar!'
timeline.quote: "For Zendikar, Commander, I will battle too."

timeline.summary: Enkindi, sent by Gideon, invites Drana's army to join Gideon's stand at Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: "Win. We can win. Many of you are still strong. We know what you can do in battle. Join us."

timeline.summary: Nissa recalls that Gideon and Jace did not understand her account of Zendikar's lost soul.
timeline.quote: She had told them that something horrible had happened to Zendikar's soul.

timeline.summary: Munda tells Nissa about Gideon's army and his plan to retake Sea Gate; Nissa silently disagrees with 'taking back' Zendikar.
timeline.quote: As one, we'll reclaim Sea Gate.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya set off to return to Sea Gate and join Gideon's battle cry.
timeline.quote: Nissa and Ashaya would return to Sea Gate, they would meet Gideon's army

timeline.summary: The falling man survives the impact in a flash of golden light and introduces himself as Gideon Jura, looking for Noyan.
timeline.quote: I'm Gideon Jura. I'm looking for the roilmage, Noyan Dar.

timeline.summary: Gideon asks for the roilmages' help at Sea Gate; Noyan objects that they are not elementalists and are in training.
timeline.quote: We need your help at Sea Gate.

timeline.summary: Noyan explains through the story of Ula and the sneeze that the Roil is the world's natural defense against the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: The Roil built up over time as a natural defense against the presence of the Eldrazi.

timeline.summary: Llura leads the full litany, and Gideon, doubting the roilmages, is moved to say this may not have been a good idea.
timeline.quote: Maybe . . . maybe this was not a good idea,

timeline.summary: Angered, Noyan insists on a practical demonstration, and the group travels to Tazeem to find an Eldrazi herd.
timeline.quote: "A practical demonstration is in order," Noyan said. "I insist."

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi swarm toward Gideon and Noyan while the initiates spread in a wide circle.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi slowly began swarming in the direction of Gideon and Noyan

timeline.summary: The initiates work the circle while Noyan gathers irritation into the Roil as Gideon holds the Eldrazi at bay.
timeline.quote: the large circle of earth surrounding Gideon and Noyan began to rotate in one direction and then the other.

timeline.summary: Noyan unleashes the Roil, collapsing the ground into a chasm that kills the Eldrazi horde and drops Gideon with it.
timeline.quote: Noyan cast his spell.

timeline.summary: Gideon survives the fall, apologizes for his doubt and asks the roilmages to join the defense of Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: I am sorry, Noyan, for any doubt. That display was amazing.

timeline.summary: Noyan agrees that the roilmages will come to Sea Gate the next day.
timeline.quote: We will be there.

timeline.summary: Noyan realizes Gideon's last question about Cosi and Ula was a hint that he had been manipulated by his own pride.
timeline.quote: Noyan Dar's elation turned into a very flat stare.

timeline.summary: The army descends from the hedrons of Emeria, and Gideon leads its first march on Sea Gate with a shout of "For Zendikar!"
timeline.quote: He shouted, "For Zendikar!" and a deafening roar came in answer.

timeline.summary: Gideon leads a headlong charge against Eldrazi spawn and larger Eldrazi near Sea Gate, while many soldiers die.
timeline.quote: The spawn fell quickly under the initial charge

timeline.summary: Gideon recalls losing his Irregulars on Theros and fears he is again leading people to their deaths.
timeline.quote: So many of the Zendikari were dying.

timeline.summary: Cut off from his army, Gideon joins Munda, who tells him the army cannot win that day.
timeline.quote: "We're not going to win this," Munda said. "Not today."

timeline.summary: Gideon orders a retreat, which turns into a rout as the army dissolves, leaving Gideon, Munda and a few soldiers to hold off the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: The ordered retreat turned into a rout.

timeline.summary: Tazri sounds a horn to rally the survivors, and the army regroups at camp as the sun sets.
timeline.quote: As the sun touched the horizon, the army of Zendikar was coming back together.

timeline.summary: Tazri tells Gideon the battle was a disaster because he led from the front and gave his army no plan or strategy.
timeline.quote: They need to know how they fit into the army and the overall plan of attack.

timeline.summary: Gideon realizes he has failed his commanders as well as his army and takes Tazri and Munda to work out a plan.
timeline.quote: "Walk with me, Tazri," he said.

timeline.summary: Over several days Gideon meets with the commanders and builds a plan that gives every contingent a role.
timeline.quote: Over the next few days, a plan came together.

timeline.summary: The army marches again in organized ranks to the beat of a conch-shell drum, with Noyan Dar's roilmages held back.
timeline.quote: They marched.

timeline.summary: A scout reports a fleet of sea monsters swimming toward Sea Gate and leaving Eldrazi remains behind them, and Gideon takes them for allies.
timeline.quote: "Allies, then," Gideon said. "At least for now."

timeline.summary: At dusk the army retreats in a planned maneuver and Drana's vampires take the front ranks, fighting through the night.
timeline.quote: But the maneuver went off without incident.

timeline.summary: Kiora appears on the tentacle of an enormous octopus and introduces herself, claiming command of her own army and the city.
timeline.quote: "I am Kiora," the merfolk said.

timeline.summary: On the fourth day the army reaches the outer wall and then surges through it into Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: the army of Zendikar surged through the wall and entered Sea Gate.

timeline.summary: Elementals of tree and stone march through Sea Gate crushing the Eldrazi, and Gideon sees that Nissa has returned bringing Zendikar with her.
timeline.quote: Nissa had returned. And she had indeed brought Zendikar with her.

timeline.summary: The tide turns, and the Zendikari drive the Eldrazi out of the city.
timeline.quote: And the Zendikari had the upper hand. They were going to win!

timeline.summary: Fighting stops and Gideon sees from the lighthouse that the army has reclaimed Sea Gate from the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: But Sea Gate was theirs.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Nissa and Kiora gather in the lighthouse, and Jori En bursts in to warn that Ulamog is coming.
timeline.quote: "Ulamog is coming!"

timeline.summary: Kiora climbs the lighthouse and enters Gideon's meeting of advisors uninvited.
timeline.quote: Her lack of invitation was clearly an oversight. She marched in.

timeline.summary: Jori En bursts in with news that Ulamog is coming and that Jace delayed her return so she could warn them.
timeline.quote: Ulamog is coming!

timeline.summary: Tazri argues for evacuation while Drana, Nissa and Kiora argue for an assault.
timeline.quote: An assault is the only reason I'm here,

timeline.summary: Gideon, after a moment alone, orders that they will not evacuate but stay, fight and kill the titan.
timeline.quote: We do not evacuate. We stay and we fight. And we kill the titan.

timeline.summary: Gideon assigns Nissa to lead land forces and Kiora to coordinate a sea attack.
timeline.quote: you will coordinate a sea attack.

timeline.summary: Ebi brings Jace to the lighthouse, and Gideon embraces his friend.
timeline.quote: Gideon closed the distance and embraced the smaller man

timeline.summary: Jace pitches the hedron trap, but Kiora insists on attacking with the bident and Nissa objects to trapping the titan.
timeline.quote: One hedron alone isn't enough

timeline.summary: Jace warns that a failed assault could drive Ulamog onto another world, but Kiora strikes at him with the bident and leaves on a tentacle; Gideon deflects the blow.
timeline.quote: Gideon was deflecting the strike of Kiora's bident meant for Jace.

timeline.summary: Gideon orders the army to build the trap and assigns commanders to patrols, telling them to keep Kiora from interfering.
timeline.quote: We will build the trap, and once we have secured our target, we will launch our offensive as planned.

timeline.summary: Through the night Nissa and Ashaya dig up hedrons and the kor and Zendikari teams hoist them into the ring over the water.
timeline.quote: They pulled and tightened their ropes in opposite directions, slowing the hedron to a gentle stop.

timeline.summary: At dawn Seble sees Ulamog approaching, and Nissa restrains the urge to attack it alone.
timeline.quote: And that's when she saw the titan.

timeline.summary: Gideon stands alone before Ulamog while Jace rehearses the trap with illusions, and Ulamog lurches into the ring.
timeline.quote: as Ulamog lurched through.

timeline.summary: The ring fails to light because of a misaligned hedron.
timeline.quote: The ring didn't flare to life like it was supposed to.

timeline.summary: Gideon, nearly overwhelmed by Ulamog, holds out until a blue flash lifts the pressure and the titan is pulled into the glowing prison.
timeline.quote: Ulamog had been pulled within the bounds of the hedron prison

timeline.summary: The Zendikari cheer that Ulamog is trapped.
timeline.quote: They had done it. Ulamog was trapped.

timeline.summary: Chandra watches Gideon direct the placement of a hedron into the ring over the water.
timeline.quote: One of the larger hedrons, hovering over the water, was moving .

timeline.summary: Gideon arrives on Zendikar, defends the Zendikari, faces a titan and leaves to seek reinforcements on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: Vowing to return, he left in search of aid at the center of Planeswalker activity: the city-world of Ravnica.

timeline.summary: Gideon recruits Jace on Ravnica but not Liliana or Chandra, and the two return to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Together, Gideon and Jace returned to Zendikar to face the threat of the Eldrazi.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Jace find Sea Gate overrun and hold off the Eldrazi so survivors can flee.
timeline.quote: the two were able to hold off the Eldrazi to allow survivors to flee to safety.

timeline.summary: Gideon gathers Drana, Noyan Dar, Tazri, Nissa and Kiora's forces and retakes Sea Gate from the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: Together, their combined forces managed to wrest Sea Gate away from the Eldrazi invaders.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Jace and Nissa trap Ulamog in a ring of hedrons at Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Gideon lured the titan into the center of the ring while the other two activated the network, imprisoning Ulamog.

timeline.summary: Gideon attacks the trapped Ulamog, but Ob Nixilis calls Kozilek from beneath Zendikar, leaving two titans rampaging.
timeline.quote: Ob Nixilis had called Kozilek, one of the other Eldrazi titans, from beneath Zendikar's surface.

timeline.summary: Nissa heaves the last hedron into place, trapping Ulamog, and prepares to destroy him while Jace outlines a plan.
timeline.quote: Nissa had heaved the last hedron into place , trapping Ulamog, the monster that had ravaged her world.

timeline.summary: Gideon tears Ob Nixilis's wing and confronts him, declaring the people under his protection.
timeline.quote: These people are under my protection, demon.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Ob Nixilis fight, and Ob Nixilis breaks the telepath's confidence in Gideon and kills six stragglers.
timeline.quote: Six dead.

timeline.summary: Gideon breaks Ob Nixilis's knee with a joint lock, but the demon pins him.
timeline.quote: The knee cracked and a sickening jolt pulsed through my body.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis drowns Gideon in muddy water, and Gideon's body goes limp.
timeline.quote: Invulnerability proved no match for three inches of dirty water.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Vorik, dying, names Gideon Jura his successor, and Tazri feels betrayed.
timeline.quote: when I am gone, you will lead these people.

timeline.summary: Vision of the future: Tazri serves Kozilek and watches him kill Gideon, the other planeswalkers lying dead.
timeline.quote: Gideon Jura burst, and a bloody bag of ruptured flesh and broken bones fell limply to the ash-white earth below

timeline.summary: Vision of the future: Kozilek repeatedly resurrects and kills Gideon for amusement.
timeline.quote: Another twitch, another ripple , and Gideon Jura was reborn again

timeline.summary: Vision of the future: Tazri tells herself the story of the day Gideon died through the dead cosmos.
timeline.quote: This is the story of the day Gideon died.

timeline.summary: Chandra finds Gideon, Jace and Nissa suspended in midair by enervating magic and challenges the demon.
timeline.quote: I'm inviting myself,

timeline.summary: The captives vanish into invisibility and reappear as the demon seizes Gideon by the neck.
timeline.quote: The demon already had him by the neck, raising him up off his feet.

timeline.summary: Chandra, Gideon, Jace and Nissa attack the demon together and defeat him.
timeline.quote: All four of them attacked the demon simultaneously.

timeline.summary: Chandra and the others reunite as Nissa introduces herself, and the Eldrazi swarm Chandra lured arrives.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi swarm, the same horde that Chandra had lured away from Sea Gate, came skittering into the chamber

timeline.summary: Gideon leads the planeswalkers out of the cavern and they scatter the Eldrazi swarm at the cave mouth.
timeline.quote: Gideon was the first to emerge from the cavern

timeline.summary: From the mountains Gideon sees the ruin of Sea Gate and the two titans creeping across the land, and realizes his army is gone.
timeline.quote: His army was gone.

timeline.summary: Jace stops Gideon from making empty promises to a distraught Nissa.
timeline.quote: Don't make promises you can't keep,

timeline.summary: Gideon realizes none of them have left and argues that together the four can stand against the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: But maybe four of us can,

timeline.summary: Gideon swears an oath to keep watch against all threats to the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: For Sea Gate, for Zendikar and all its people, for justice and peace, I will keep watch.

timeline.summary: The four set out to find Tazri and form a plan.
timeline.quote: I left Tazri and a small group of soldiers a couple miles back that way.

timeline.summary: The four planeswalkers enter a ravine covered in Kozilek's trail and find Tazri, Munda, Jori En, Kiora and Drana's emissary arguing over a strike plan.
timeline.quote: Standing tall, bident in hand, cocky smile still in place, was the merfolk Planeswalker Kiora

timeline.summary: Gideon is reunited with the group, and Kiora offers a humble request for the next move.
timeline.quote: Which is why I'm here, now, asking you what we are going to do.

timeline.summary: Jace announces that since they cannot trap the titans nor let them leave, they will kill them, revealing Ugin's warning he had promised to heed.
timeline.quote: We're going to kill them.

timeline.summary: Jace proposes using the army as bait to bring the titans together, and Tazri says bait does not get a choice.
timeline.quote: The titans are drawn to concentrations of life,

timeline.summary: Jace explains Ugin's metaphor and concludes the titans can be pulled fully into the physical world to be killed.
timeline.quote: we pull the two titans into the physical world completely, and then we can kill them.

timeline.summary: Jace lays out the plan: lure the titans into an ambush, bind them with Nissa's leylines, and drain them, with Kiora clearing the basin and Chandra told not to attack the titans.
timeline.quote: When the time comes, Nissa weaves the leylines together and binds the titans.

timeline.summary: Jace warns that the titans may get bigger as they are drawn into physical space, and Kiora agrees to follow the plan with a warning.
timeline.quote: Meaning they may get, um, bigger,

timeline.summary: Gideon tells Jace he trusts him despite the demon's warning about telepaths.
timeline.quote: I trust you,

timeline.summary: Gideon wakes before dawn and runs unarmored around the Sky Rock encampment, reflecting on Jace, Nissa and Chandra as the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: This was his ritual, if it could be called that after only three days

timeline.summary: Tazri, now Commander-General, runs with Gideon and tells him she is addressing departing volunteers.
timeline.quote: The burden of command. It was now hers—Commander-General Tazri.

timeline.summary: Gideon says he is hers to command until he must go elsewhere to face new threats.
timeline.quote: he had pledged to the Gatewatch to intervene where others couldn't.

timeline.summary: Gideon tells Chandra the Eldrazi sweep seems done, and Chandra insists she is part of the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: I'm in this, Gideon. I'm part of the Gatewatch now.

timeline.summary: Ugin lands furiously among the Zendikari, demanding to know what Jace has done.
timeline.quote: What have you done?

timeline.summary: Ugin scolds the planeswalkers for killing two ancient beings, says he will study their remains, tells Jace to leave, and warns of Sorin and Bolas.
timeline.quote: have proven to be an extremely arrogant and unreliable partner.

timeline.summary: Ugin departs, and Jace and Gideon decide that Jace will go to Innistrad to find Sorin Markov.
timeline.quote: I'll go to Innistrad and find Sorin.

timeline.summary: Chandra leads the group that baits Ulamog, while Gideon leads the other bait army toward Kozilek, toward Jace and Nissa waiting in the titans' path.
timeline.quote: The plan involved being as noticeably, tantalizingly alive as possible

timeline.summary: The two bait armies cross in front of Nissa and Jace, and Jace signals them to disperse.
timeline.quote: Disperse the army. The titans are in position!

timeline.summary: Chandra wants to burn the titans but Jace forbids it, since damage would collapse the glyph.
timeline.quote: Any damage to the titans or to Nissa will snap the leylines and collapse the glyph spell.

timeline.summary: Kiora argues that Zendikar will die with the titans and demands Nissa let them go; Jace insists they must be destroyed here.
timeline.quote: Zendikar will perish if they do.

timeline.summary: Gideon sides with Chandra, and Jace asks Chandra if she is certain she can destroy the titans with one spell.
timeline.quote: I'm certain

timeline.summary: Chandra's spell fails to be enough as Gideon blocks a falling landmass with his own body.
timeline.quote: Gideon leaping from the outcropping, blocking the landmass with his own body

timeline.summary: Survivors gather in the ash with no celebration, and Kiora leaves with the bident.
timeline.quote: And she didn't stop walking for a long time.

timeline.summary: Jace tells Liliana he and Gideon saved a plane and took an oath to keep fighting interplanar threats.
timeline.quote: We even took an oath, to...to keep doing this.

timeline.summary: Jace recalls Gideon told him to return to Zendikar if he heard of a titan.
timeline.quote: Gideon himself had told Jace to come back to Zendikar if he heard news of the titan.

timeline.summary: Jace arrives to Chandra's greeting and the smiling face of his friend.
timeline.quote: the afterimage of Emrakul looming above gave way to the smiling face of his friend.

timeline.summary: Gideon arrives and slays the mutated creature as it corners Jace.
timeline.quote: "It's fine, Jace. I've got your back."

timeline.summary: Chandra and Nissa arrive, and Jace lays out the plan: Nissa taps the leylines with her glyph, Gideon clears a path, and Chandra channels the energy.
timeline.quote: Nissa will use her planar glyph to tap into the leyline network.

timeline.summary: Chandra unleashes a huge firestorm against the mutated horde, scorching her friends, and the group is trapped in a market square.
timeline.quote: They were trapped in what had been a market square

timeline.summary: Nissa begins the planar glyph in the market square while Gideon charges the horde to protect her.
timeline.quote: He roared a challenge as he slashed in a wide circle

timeline.summary: Chandra refuses to leave: they all walk out together or not at all.
timeline.quote: "Not gonna happen. We're all walking out of here together, or..."

timeline.summary: Nissa and Gideon recoil from the Chain Veil, while Chandra defends Liliana as having saved them.
timeline.quote: "That...thing she carries. It's an abomination."

timeline.summary: Gideon asks Jace to decide whether Liliana can be trusted, and Liliana asks what their plan is now.
timeline.quote: So tell me, brave heroes, what's your plan now?

timeline.summary: Emrakul unfolds, growing countless tendrils and releasing a wave of power that hits every planeswalker.
timeline.quote: in that shifting Emrakul unfolded

timeline.summary: The other planeswalkers collapse under Emrakul's mental assault, except Jace, who casts a spell in response.
timeline.quote: The other Planeswalkers crumpled, all except Jace, who cast some type of spell in response.

timeline.summary: Jace sees in a window Gideon, addressed as Kytheon Iora, questioned by the celestial Erebos, who threatens to kill his friends unless he says what he most desires.
timeline.quote: It is not an offer, mortal.

timeline.summary: Gideon asks Tamiyo to join the Gatewatch and she excuses herself.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo shook her head, excusing herself

timeline.summary: Liliana swears the Gatewatch oath to Gideon with calculated sincerity and becomes a member.
timeline.quote: I see that together we're more powerful than we are alone.

timeline.summary: In the courtyard Nissa conjures a bush-beast that drives Gideon into the ground, testing his indestructibility.
timeline.quote: Its front limbs interlaced into a single fist, which it drove down on Gideon like an avalanche.

timeline.summary: Gideon asks Nissa if his habit of clapping shoulders makes her uncomfortable and promises to stop.
timeline.quote: That thing I do, where I clap people on the shoulder? Does that make you uncomfortable?

timeline.summary: Gideon realizes Baan wants the Gatewatch to provide security and hunt the renegades.
timeline.quote: So, to be clear, you want the Gatewatch to provide...security?

timeline.summary: Baan asks who makes decisions for the group, and Jace and Gideon each fumble to name a leader.
timeline.quote: Gideon is the battlefield commander...

timeline.summary: Gideon invites Baan to stay for dinner and a tour of the headquarters.
timeline.quote: Minister, you should at least stay for dinner.

timeline.summary: Jace asks Gideon to investigate the petrifications and work with the Azorius.
timeline.quote: I'd like you to investigate this.

timeline.summary: Gideon's punching bag bursts into flames and Chandra puts it out with a bucket, leaving a sand pile.
timeline.quote: The canvas of Gids's punchybag bursts into flames.

timeline.summary: Chandra rushes past Baan and Gideon, apologizing for blowing up the punching bag.
timeline.quote: SorryIblewupyourthingy

timeline.summary: Nissa, daydreaming of waking as a seed in the dark, is jolted back by Gideon at dinner.
timeline.quote: I'm not a seed.

timeline.summary: Gideon tells Baan about what Nissa and Chandra did on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: I was telling Minister Baan what you did on Zendikar.

timeline.summary: Gideon defends Chandra, saying her parents' sins have nothing to do with her.
timeline.quote: But her heart's the size of the moon.

timeline.summary: Lavinia stops Jace from leaving to find Chandra, saying Gideon and Nissa can search for Monk Nalaar.
timeline.quote: They can find Monk Nalaar.

timeline.summary: Jace abandons Ral and goes to fetch Gideon.
timeline.quote: dodged down an alleyway to fetch Gideon.

timeline.summary: Jace, Liliana and Gideon, disguised as Consulate soldiers, drop their illusions and reunite with Chandra, Nissa, Ajani and Mrs. Pashiri.
timeline.quote: It seems this is a matter for the Gatewatch,

timeline.summary: Illusions behind Chandra dissolve to reveal the Gatewatch, and Tezzeret takes a small step backward.
timeline.quote: A host of illusions dissolved behind Chandra, and one by one, a team of Planeswalkers emerged.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers battle Tezzeret's automatons while Ajani and Gideon protect Pia.
timeline.quote: Fire flew, slamming like fists into Tezzeret's machines, felling one after another.

timeline.summary: Chandra introduces Yahenni to Jace, Liliana and Gideon; Chandra says they got her mother free.
timeline.quote: Yahenni, this man is Jace, this woman is Liliana, and the man in the corner is Gideon.

timeline.summary: Yahenni warns that the Consulate is on its way and offers their penthouse as a safe hideout; the group agrees.
timeline.quote: My penthouse is safe.

timeline.summary: Nissa has Gideon call back Chandra, who walked the wrong way, and directs the group to Yahenni's home and sends word to Ajani, Pia and Mrs. Pashiri.
timeline.quote: Tell Chandra Yahenni's home is that way, and have Jace inform Ajani, Pia, and Mrs. Pashiri of our new location

timeline.summary: Gideon weighs, over coffee, whether the Gatewatch should be taking sides in Kaladesh's local conflict.
timeline.quote: should the Gatewatch be taking sides in this local conflict ?

timeline.summary: A thopter signals Gideon that Pia has news, and he returns to Yahenni's penthouse.
timeline.quote: Gideon sighed. Pia had news.

timeline.summary: On the roof, Gideon tells Chandra the Gatewatch came for her, not to topple the Consulate; Chandra accuses him of silence.
timeline.quote: "We came for you."

timeline.summary: Chandra agrees to focus on stopping Tezzeret, while also helping her mother as Pia Nalaar's daughter.
timeline.quote: And, as much as I hate it, I'll try to focus on stopping Tezzeret....for now.

timeline.summary: Gideon confronts Liliana for killing Consulate forces; she argues death is a tool and they had to.
timeline.quote: "We don't kill."

timeline.summary: Liliana says there is just one person she wants to kill on this plane and tells Gideon Tezzeret destroyed something that was hers.
timeline.quote: "He hurt something important to me. Destroyed something that was mine."

timeline.summary: Gideon withstands a charging Consulate charger in Bomat and shields its driver.
timeline.quote: The charger smashed into Gideon.

timeline.summary: A Consulate automaton knocks Gideon through a wall.
timeline.quote: a massive metallic fist slammed into Gideon, sending him flying and crashing through the wall of a nearby building.

timeline.summary: Saheeli reassembles scrap into replica automatons and uses a golden automaton to destroy the Consulate automaton.
timeline.quote: Saheeli pumped a fist in triumph.

timeline.summary: Liliana volunteers to infiltrate with Saheeli; Gideon reluctantly agrees and tells her to do what is right.
timeline.quote: "Fine. Liliana will go."

timeline.summary: Pia proposes the renegades capture the Aether Hub to cut power to the Spire, and reveals they have a big invention only needing aether.
timeline.quote: "We take the Aether Hub."

timeline.summary: Gideon assigns roles: Pia and Chandra mobilize the renegades while he, Nissa, Jace and Ajani create disruption against the Consulate.
timeline.quote: We're going to run disruption until the renegades are ready to begin the assault.

timeline.summary: Gideon persuades Chandra to lead by example for the renegades instead of joining the diversion.
timeline.quote: "Lead by example. Lead by your strength."

timeline.summary: Consulate forces arrive and Gideon readies to fight.
timeline.quote: "They're there! Stop them!"

timeline.summary: Gideon watches the Skysovereign sink; Jace and Kari have broken the blockade, and Gideon insists the target is the Planar Bridge.
timeline.quote: "It's fallen," Gideon said. "And the blockade's gone with it.

timeline.summary: Pia, Saheeli and Rashmi reveal Hope of Ghirapur, a modified thopter carrying an aetheric disruptor to cripple the Planar Bridge.
timeline.quote: "Rashmi and Saheeli have designed a specially modified thopter," said Pia.

timeline.summary: Gideon keeps Chandra on the ship while Nissa and Ajani join Pia on the ground team.
timeline.quote: "I'll go along with the ground team," Ajani said.

timeline.summary: Liliana convinces a reluctant Gideon that she must go alone and unarmed to duel and distract Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: I have to go alone, unarmed, or else your whole plan falls apart.

timeline.summary: Saheeli discovers the hollowed-out thopter; the group debates calling off the attack.
timeline.quote: "We need to call it off," he said.

timeline.summary: Chandra proposes to be the disruptor herself by riding the thopter into the Bridge; Gideon objects but she insists.
timeline.quote: "From close range, I could be the disruptor.

timeline.summary: Gideon relents and decides to go with Chandra.
timeline.quote: "You're not going alone."

timeline.summary: Gideon shields Chandra with his golden glow as she builds a star of flame for the impact.
timeline.quote: "I've got you," he said. "You're safe."

timeline.summary: Liliana searches the rubble and reflects that she needs Chandra and the Gatewatch as powerful tools to free herself from her demons.
timeline.quote: She needed powerful people, and she'd found them.

timeline.summary: Liliana finds Chandra and Gideon alive; Tezzeret is either buried or has fled to his master.
timeline.quote: "He's either buried in this rubble or run home to his master."

timeline.summary: At Yahenni's penthouse the Gatewatch gather before the party; Gideon forces himself to smile.
timeline.quote: Nonetheless, even here where no one but his friends could see him, Gideon smiled.

timeline.summary: Gideon invites Ajani to join the Gatewatch, and Ajani speaks the oath.
timeline.quote: "Never again," said Ajani. "Until all have found their place, I will keep watch."

timeline.summary: Liliana's briefing on Tezzeret and Amonkhet leads the Gatewatch to discuss stopping Bolas, whom Liliana says controls and may have created Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: "Bolas controls the place completely. As far as I know, he created it."

timeline.summary: Ajani reveals he once defeated Bolas in the Maelstrom, warns against going to Amonkhet and asks them to gather allies first.
timeline.quote: "Give me time to get some of those friends together.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch, except an unsure Nissa, vote to strike at Bolas now; Gideon decides to meet Ajani after facing Bolas.
timeline.quote: "Then we'll meet Ajani there...after we face Bolas."

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch's five planeswalkers appear in the middle of an Amonkhet sandstorm.
timeline.quote: Five figures stood where none were moments ago, caught by surprise in the blinding sands.

timeline.summary: Flashback: on a Kaladesh rooftop, after Ajani leaves, the Gatewatch plans to go to Amonkhet, with Liliana navigating, to find and stop Bolas.
timeline.quote: We go to Amonkhet and learn what we can of Nicol Bolas's plans, then neutralize the threat he poses

timeline.summary: Flashback: the five planeswalk from Ghirapur.
timeline.quote: We traveled infinitely far yet not at all, standing still yet moving at blinding speeds.

timeline.summary: Chandra melts sand into a glass dome to shelter the group from the storm.
timeline.quote: I step forward and shape the still-liquid glass into a simple, crude dome.

timeline.summary: Liliana admits she knows little of where Bolas is; Nissa senses the plane's leylines are weak, and Chandra spots Bolas's horns on the horizon.
timeline.quote: the massive shadow of two horns pierces the sky

timeline.summary: Undead burst from the sand and grab Jace; the group fights a horde while Liliana commands undead to obey, assist and flee.
timeline.quote: rotting hands burst forth from the sand, grabbed Jace by the legs, and pulled him under.

timeline.summary: Giant sand wurms erupt, and one swallows Liliana whole.
timeline.quote: I watched in horror she disappeared into the gullet of an enormous wurm.

timeline.summary: Gideon, buried under undead, is rescued by Nissa and the two fight toward Chandra.
timeline.quote: Suddenly the limbs of the zombie holding my right arm were no longer attached to its torso.

timeline.summary: Gideon kills one wurm from the inside and is flung by another; Jace proposes retreating to Kaladesh.
timeline.quote: I ran forward and leaped into its open maw

timeline.summary: Two zombified wurms attack; one coils around Nissa while Liliana lies in danger, forcing Gideon to choose.
timeline.quote: I stood, suspended, for a fraction of a second, fully aware that not making a choice meant choosing death for them both.

timeline.summary: A blazing white arrow kills the wurm over Liliana and a towering jackal-headed figure destroys the others and saves the group.
timeline.quote: She towered above me, standing at the height of a dozen men, golden headdress gleaming in the sun

timeline.summary: Gideon realizes there are gods on Amonkhet, in the world of Bolas.
timeline.quote: There are gods on Amonkhet.

timeline.summary: The group reaches a ridge and sees a barrier-shielded city of obelisks and temples on a river.
timeline.quote: all of which formed a sprawling city that spanned as far as we could see.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch decides to descend toward the city and its barrier.
timeline.quote: "Only one way to find out."

timeline.summary: Gideon comforts Chandra, and they recall how they met and the Purifying Fire; Chandra confesses guilt over the Sanctum of Stars and asks for a hug.
timeline.quote: He's standing with arms wide, smiling.

timeline.summary: Nissa finds Chandra in Gideon's arms, and Chandra awkwardly tries to explain.
timeline.quote: Nissa sets a plate of eggplant and potato curry on one of the benches

timeline.summary: Baral's amplified voice taunts Chandra about her father's death and her mother's imprisonment, goading her into running out; Nissa follows.
timeline.quote: Have you told your friends the story? About how you got daddy killed?

timeline.summary: Gideon, torn, asks Nissa to keep Chandra safe and returns to the Hub's defenses.
timeline.quote: "Keep her safe."

timeline.summary: Gideon is stomped by a Gearhulk, survives, and climbs it to survey the battle.
timeline.quote: "It's all right," he called, with forced cheer. "I'm indestructible."

timeline.summary: Gideon drops into a Gearhulk's gears and wrecks it from inside; Shadowblayde's crew rescues him.
timeline.quote: He looked into the gap between the armor, took a few rapid breaths, and dropped into the gears.

timeline.summary: Gideon sees Consulate thopters approaching the Hub and rushes back.
timeline.quote: "Get back to the Hub!" he shouted, breaking into a run.

timeline.summary: Gideon carries the wounded Chandra to the Heart of Kiran hanging over Weldfast, where the renegades have retreated.
timeline.quote: Heart of Kiran had carried the escapees from the Aether Hub to the safety of Weldfast, solidly renegade territory.

timeline.summary: Ajani heals Mrs. Pashiri and tells Chandra it was not her fault.
timeline.quote: This was not your fault, Chandra.

timeline.summary: Gideon, ruminating on whether the gods are Bolas's agents or his opponents, trudges through the desert with the group.
timeline.quote: To see gods wading amidst the horrors of the desert had not been among them.

timeline.summary: Liliana and Chandra clear zombies at the dome and Jace and Nissa open a hole in the Hekma, and the group enters the city.
timeline.quote: a hole a little wider than Jace's outstretched arms opened to admit them.

timeline.summary: An aven vizier arrives to repair the barrier and questions their strange clothes; Jace reads his mind and bluffs a cover story about a faraway district.
timeline.quote: Well, of course, that's why I'm here in the . . . Nitin district, to teach you.

timeline.summary: Gideon decides they should keep their other-planar origin hidden despite Chandra's wish to open the people's eyes.
timeline.quote: We shouldn't draw attention to ourselves any more than we need to

timeline.summary: Liliana charms Temmet by claiming they were on a mission for the Horned One, and the group learns the standard greeting.
timeline.quote: "We have been out in the desert for some time," she said, "on a special mission for the Horned One."

timeline.summary: Temmet leads them through the city, where they see people training and the Anointed doing all labor.
timeline.quote: "The Anointed perform all the work here, so the living need do nothing but train.

timeline.summary: Gideon meets the god Oketra, who names him Kytheon Iora and says the others' fates are undecided.
timeline.quote: "You're one of mine, Kytheon Iora," she said.

timeline.summary: Gideon recalls Heliod and the death of his Irregulars, doubting he can trust a god again.
timeline.quote: The mission Heliod had set before him had led to the death of Gideon's closest friends, his Irregulars.

timeline.summary: Temmet lodges them in two rooms; Gideon watches Oketra walk to her temple.
timeline.quote: Liliana swept into one of the rooms and closed the door without a word.

timeline.summary: On the balcony Gideon tells Chandra his birth name was Kytheon Iora and explains what gods are and how Oketra differs.
timeline.quote: "Kytheon," he said. "Kytheon Iora."

timeline.summary: A woman runs through the street shouting that the trials, gods and hours are lies; soldiers including a minotaur capture her while Gideon restrains Chandra.
timeline.quote: "The return will bring only devastation and ruin!"

timeline.summary: Gideon promises to quietly investigate and says there is no deception in Oketra, while Jace and Liliana doubt gods.
timeline.quote: But there is no deception in Oketra.

timeline.summary: Unable to sleep, Gideon seeks out Oketra at dawn, telling her he seeks her.
timeline.quote: "You," he said.

timeline.summary: Oketra appears, forbids approaching the sarcophagi, and Nissa tells her telepathically that her world is dying; Oketra shows fear and has no memory of before.
timeline.quote: " These sarcophagi are forbidden to approach ," Oketra said out loud.

timeline.summary: Gideon reveals he is competing in the Trials as Oketra's Champion despite Chandra's objections.
timeline.quote: "These gods are good at their core. I want to prove myself to them."

timeline.summary: Gideon follows Oketra through Naktamun and watches her warm, kind interactions with the people.
timeline.quote: There was no groveling, no fear from the masses before an almighty presence.

timeline.summary: Gideon, wearing a cartouche Oketra gave him, comes to a celebration square where initiates feast before the Trial of Ambition.
timeline.quote: I noticed all these initiates had cartouches with three segments.

timeline.summary: Oketra tells Gideon this is where the Trials begin, then leaves him with the initiate Djeru, who greets him as a friend.
timeline.quote: I am Djeru of the Tah crop.

timeline.summary: Djeru spars with Gideon and wins, then introduces him to the crop.
timeline.quote: You're good. You could be better. Come.

timeline.summary: Gideon learns that crops lose members through the Trials, and Djeru's crop is replacing one lost the day before.
timeline.quote: Many other crops are culled significantly from Trial to Trial, and reformed with others.

timeline.summary: Meris names the lost dissenter Samut, angering Djeru, who explains she chose heresy and was removed; Gideon recalls seeing a woman shouting that the gods lie.
timeline.quote: She is a dissenter ,

timeline.summary: Bontu stalks into the square and asks who deserves to compete in her Trial; Gideon boldly asks whether even the gods are born strong.
timeline.quote: Not even the gods?

timeline.summary: Bontu laughs at Gideon's brazenness and names him and the twenty members of the Tah crop as the next to face her Trial.
timeline.quote: You shall be next to face my Trial

timeline.summary: Dedi wades into a filth pool to turn a crank that raises a bridge, but acid filth floods the chamber and dissolves him as the crop flees; one initiate is lost.
timeline.quote: skin and flesh sloughed off his forearm, revealing bone.

timeline.summary: Djeru and Tausret insist the crop press on, calling Dedi's death glorious, which disturbs Gideon.
timeline.quote: Dedi died a glorious death.

timeline.summary: Gideon charges the ammit and finds his sural cannot cut it; his golden shield holds but cannot free him from its grip.
timeline.quote: Golden ripples of light danced across my body as I focused my magic

timeline.summary: Hepthys drives the ammit off Gideon with wind magic and is caught in the air and devoured.
timeline.quote: swallowing its prize in two snapping bites.

timeline.summary: Djeru rebukes Gideon for treating each glorious death as a tragedy and sends the crop through a corridor of bladed pendulums in order of speed.
timeline.quote: What is wrong with you?

timeline.summary: Gideon uses his golden shield to smash through the swinging blades, disabling the trap, and Djeru grows suspicious of his abilities.
timeline.quote: The first one smashed into me, shattering and launching me into the wall

timeline.summary: Four initiates volunteer to stand on pillars to open the door while holding the ammit and monsters; Djeru swaps Masika for Tausret and the four are left behind.
timeline.quote: Masika. I need you to switch with Tausret.

timeline.summary: Gideon is rebuked for wanting to stay and the crop leaves the four to die.
timeline.quote: Where is your ambition?

timeline.summary: The nine survivors reach Bontu's summit chamber, having lost Imi to scarabs, and Bontu displays a scale at a bridge across serpent-filled water.
timeline.quote: We were now nine.

timeline.summary: Bontu announces her toll of one heart from each, saying the initiates' numbers are too great.
timeline.quote: Pay the toll, or fall short and perish.

timeline.summary: Bontu drains Gideon's strength with her gaze and commands him to watch while Djeru finishes the killing.
timeline.quote: Watch, Kytheon Iora. Quiet your judgment, and learn.

timeline.summary: Gideon furiously denounces the slaughter and dives across to confront Bontu, who calls him brazen and ignorant of her world.
timeline.quote: What mockery of faith and divinity is this madness?

timeline.summary: Bontu rebukes Gideon as shallow and selfish for judging instead of understanding, and tells him doubt is the shadow of faith.
timeline.quote: You look only for what satisfies your sense of justice.

timeline.summary: Bontu commands Gideon to leave her temple, and he exits and realizes the anointed are the remnants of fallen initiates.
timeline.quote: The anointed are the remnants of initiates fallen in battle.

timeline.summary: Gideon tears the cartouche from his neck, resolving to strike down Bolas.
timeline.quote: I tore the cartouche from my neck, dropping it on the ground before me.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Chandra free Samut from the sarcophagus, telling her they came to rescue her.
timeline.quote: He explained that they saw her days ago evading capture and came to rescue her.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch share information with Samut, learning that Bolas is a dragon from another world and has tampered with the gods.
timeline.quote: The God-Pharaoh is a dragon from another world, Samut.

timeline.summary: Liliana reveals her third demon is on Amonkhet, and the Gatewatch quarrel angrily.
timeline.quote: My third demon is here.

timeline.summary: Samut forces the group to focus on rescuing Djeru, and Gideon swears to help.
timeline.quote: I swear to help you save the life of your friend.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch fight without magic, and Samut reaches Djeru and fights alongside him.
timeline.quote: She would protect him. They would fight together.

timeline.summary: Djeru prays for Samut's forgiveness while he and Samut fight, and he slices Gideon's arm.
timeline.quote: cutting a sleek, shallow slice cut through Gideon's forearm

timeline.summary: As Hazoret strikes, Samut tackles Djeru out of the way and Gideon blocks the spear with his golden barrier.
timeline.quote: He stood between them and Hazoret's spear

timeline.summary: Djeru, enraged that his chance at a glorious death is gone, beats on Gideon and weeps that he wants to exist.
timeline.quote: Because I want to exist!

timeline.summary: Gideon, left behind, recalls Hazoret whispering to him that she sees his death and that he is no god.
timeline.quote: for I see your death, Kytheon Iora.

timeline.summary: Gideon, camouflaged by Jace, slashes Razaketh's back with his sural, freeing Liliana's breath and shielding her with his invulnerability.
timeline.quote: carving three thick lines in Razaketh's back.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Nissa and Chandra approach coldly, and Nissa warns that the bloodspell began a chain reaction that sets the Hours in motion.
timeline.quote: The Hours' that herald Nicol Bolas's return needed to be set in motion by the demon.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch resolves to find a vantage to ambush Bolas, and the others return to Naktamun, regarding Liliana coldly.
timeline.quote: Let us seek a better vantage to prepare for Nicol Bolas's arrival,

timeline.summary: Hapatra glimpses Gideon and Liliana running past, and Djeru tells her not to stop.
timeline.quote: One was Gideon, the broad-shouldered warrior Oketra had claimed as one of her own.

timeline.summary: Oketra leaps between Tuya and the scorpion god and is impaled by its stinger while Gideon cries out.
timeline.quote: the scorpion god's stinger was lodged in Oketra's gut.

timeline.summary: Hapatra weeps for her gods, then tells Gideon the source of the hell is his responsibility to kill.
timeline.quote: Then he is your responsibility to kill.

timeline.summary: Gideon blocks Neheb's spear and the Gatewatch destroy the Eternals; Samut stabs Neheb and kills him.
timeline.quote: She sprinted toward the Eternal minotaur and stabbed him in the back with both khopeshes

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch decide to bring the fight to Bolas, and Samut charges them to slay Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: Slay the dragon trespasser. Slay Nicol Bolas.

timeline.summary: Djeru persuades Samut to stand down and find the last god while the Gatewatch fight Bolas.
timeline.quote: Find the last god of Amonkhet, protect her, and protect the people of our city.

timeline.summary: Gideon, in rage, demands they fight Bolas at once, and the Gatewatch attack with everything they have.
timeline.quote: They began. Gideon charged, his golden force shield shimmering

timeline.summary: Bolas swats Gideon against a wall with his tail while ignoring the other attacks.
timeline.quote: Gideon sailed into a thick brick wall lining one side of the plaza.

timeline.summary: Liliana urges the others to retreat, then asks Bolas where he wants her to go, and flees, betraying Chandra's trust.
timeline.quote: Where . . . where do you want me to go?

timeline.summary: Chandra drives Bolas back with white fire for the first time, but he dismisses her as a child.
timeline.quote: he was forced backward for the first time in the fight

timeline.summary: Bolas corrupts the leylines Nissa controls, and Gideon's interruption lets her flee the plane.
timeline.quote: She used Gideon's interruption to flee from this dead husk of a world.

timeline.summary: Bolas grabs Gideon and pierces his shield and shoulder with a talon, then offers him the choice to stay and die or leave and live.
timeline.quote: the shield parted like melted butter

timeline.summary: Haunted by memories of lost friends, Gideon chooses to leave and live and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: He willed his body through the Blind Eternities

timeline.summary: Jace chooses to track Gideon rather than Liliana to reach Dominaria.
timeline.quote: What he felt for her now wasn't anything resembling affection.

timeline.summary: Gideon is overjoyed to see Jace alive.
timeline.quote: Gideon! I'm not dead!

timeline.summary: An older woman in red robes blocks Gideon and asks who Jace is.
timeline.quote: Who's the bookworm?

timeline.summary: Gideon arrives on Dominaria wounded after Amonkhet, with Liliana, Chandra and Nissa.
timeline.quote: Dominaria coalesced around Gideon and the first thing that struck him was the stench of rotting plants and dank earth.

timeline.summary: Gideon, wounded in the shoulder, admits the battle against Bolas did not go to plan.
timeline.quote: The second thing Gideon noticed was the hole in his shoulder and its piercing pain.

timeline.summary: Chandra asks where Jace is and Nissa says he has given up.
timeline.quote: He's given up.

timeline.summary: Nissa refuses and walks away, declaring her watch over.
timeline.quote: I'm sorry, but my watch is over.

timeline.summary: Chandra announces she will leave to become stronger.
timeline.quote: I'm going too.

timeline.summary: Gideon decides to stay and work with Liliana.
timeline.quote: I'm staying.

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Gideon the town is her birthplace.
timeline.quote: It's where I was born.

timeline.summary: At the inn, Liliana tends Gideon's wound while the innkeeper says the Cabal has taken over the region.
timeline.quote: It's the Cabal,

timeline.summary: Cabal undead knights attack the town at nightfall.
timeline.quote: She had barely started on the path through the ruins when she sensed the surge of undead malice.

timeline.summary: Liliana seizes an undead knight and saves Gideon.
timeline.quote: In the next instant, he was hers.

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Gideon the lich leading the Cabal is her brother Josu.
timeline.quote: The lich leading the Cabal forces in this area is my brother, Josu.

timeline.summary: Liliana confesses she made Josu undead as a girl.
timeline.quote: I made Josu undead, many years ago.

timeline.summary: Gideon agrees to help lay Josu to rest as the next step.
timeline.quote: Yes, that's our next step, obviously.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Liliana find Rael in a ruin and offer help against the Cabal.
timeline.quote: We know you're Rael, Battle Angel and Protector of Caligo.

timeline.summary: Rael accepts and asks to hear their plan.
timeline.quote: Tell me your plan.

timeline.summary: Gideon gathers the Benalish forces at Vess Manor.
timeline.quote: When the next day dawned, they were at the high ground around Vess Manor with a small force of Benalish soldiers, knights, and aven scouts.

timeline.summary: Gideon asks Corin to make a dread shade mistake him for a skin witch.
timeline.quote: Corin, with Liliana's help, could you create an illusion? Make a dread shade think I'm a skin witch?

timeline.summary: Corin casts the illusion over Gideon.
timeline.quote: As Corin cast the spell, Gideon felt the illusion settle over him like a wet blanket.

timeline.summary: A Cabal cleric's dementia magic shows Gideon undead versions of his friends Drasus and Olexo.
timeline.quote: They were undead, their bodies mutilated, bloodless corpses, brought here somehow by Belzenlok.

timeline.summary: Gideon spears the dread shade to lure it away from the Benalish.
timeline.quote: Gideon lunged forward and cast the spear straight at the gaping hole in the shade's chest.

timeline.summary: Gideon beheads a skin witch.
timeline.quote: The first stroke of his sword took her head off.

timeline.summary: Gideon kills the last skin witch as the illusion fades.
timeline.quote: As she fell to the ground, Gideon felt the illusion around him vanish.

timeline.summary: Gideon charges the confused dread shade to keep it busy.
timeline.quote: He roared back at the startled shade and charged.

timeline.summary: The Chain Veil blasts away the preserved manor, aging it into ruin.
timeline.quote: the Chain Veil had blasted it all away, aging the house until it was a crumbled ruin.

timeline.summary: Liliana realizes her family died trying to end the evil she created.
timeline.quote: And worse still, her family, all dead trying to end the evil she had created.

timeline.summary: Lyra Dawnbringer refuses Liliana entry to Benalia City.
timeline.quote: Your companion stinks of death magic and will not be allowed into this city.

timeline.summary: Lyra relents after reading Rael's letter vouching for Liliana.
timeline.quote: Very well. You may enter the city.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight descends to the signal tower to pick up Gideon and Liliana.
timeline.quote: as the giant skyship dropped down toward them.

timeline.summary: Ajani scolds Gideon and Liliana for going to Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: You should not have gone to Amonkhet.

timeline.summary: Gideon says they failed on Amonkhet because Liliana's demon pact held her back.
timeline.quote: But we failed on Amonkhet because Liliana was still hamstrung by her demon pact.

timeline.summary: Ajani departs to find more planeswalkers, leaving Gideon and Liliana to fight Belzenlok.
timeline.quote: I can't help you here. I must find more Planeswalkers to join the battle against Bolas.

timeline.summary: Jhoira offers the Weatherlight's help to destroy Belzenlok.
timeline.quote: I've had this ship reconstructed for the sole purpose of fighting the Cabal

timeline.summary: The group resolves to capture a high-level Cabal agent for intelligence about the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: We need to capture a high-level Cabal agent.

timeline.summary: Jodah, Dean Naban and Tolarian mages meet the Weatherlight's group.
timeline.quote: In the lead were an older man with hard features and a deceptively young-looking mage with a mane of brown hair.

timeline.summary: Jodah brings them to see something at the academy.
timeline.quote: I'm not sure how much we can help you, but there's something we'd like you to take a look at.

timeline.summary: Liliana animates a dead student to question it; nine victims were killed by dementia magic.
timeline.quote: Lying on the floor were nine corpses, students and staff of the academy.

timeline.summary: Liliana realizes the laboratory itself was the agent's target.
timeline.quote: This place was the target all along.

timeline.summary: A student named Thom emerges and claims he was studying.
timeline.quote: I'm Thom, studying artificing with Dr. Arongi.

timeline.summary: Liliana, Gideon and Shanna subdue Thom.
timeline.quote: She knocked him flat and Gideon stepped forward to kick the magical device away from his hand.

timeline.summary: Liliana admits she sees Josu all the time now.
timeline.quote: I see Josu all the time, now.

timeline.summary: Jhoira explains the Blackblade killed an elder dragon.
timeline.quote: It killed an elder dragon.

timeline.summary: Gideon refuses to use a soul-drinker under any circumstances.
timeline.quote: A soul-drinker is not something we would want to use, under any circumstances.

timeline.summary: Jhoira introduces Gideon and Liliana as planeswalkers to Teferi.
timeline.quote: Gideon and Liliana are Planeswalkers.

timeline.summary: The group escapes as sand floods the well and the Weatherlight drops ladders.
timeline.quote: The plateau is sinking.

timeline.summary: Chandra recognizes Gideon and Liliana aboard the Weatherlight as they call the group to come aboard.
timeline.quote: "Gideon!" She waved wildly.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Liliana, Jaya and Chandra discuss killing Belzenlok without the Chain Veil, and Liliana raises using the Blackblade.
timeline.quote: It's a sword that slew an elder dragon, and Gideon is too delicate to allow us to use it.

timeline.summary: Jace planeswalks onto the moving Weatherlight and warns that Bolas is preparing a trap for planeswalkers.
timeline.quote: Ajani wanted us to meet and regroup, but Bolas is preparing a trap for Planeswalkers.

timeline.summary: Jace asks Gideon and Chandra to leave with him and says Liliana cannot be trusted, but Gideon refuses and Chandra chooses to stay.
timeline.quote: You don't understand. You can't trust her.

timeline.summary: Gideon agrees to use the Blackblade if it can be found in Belzenlok's Stronghold.
timeline.quote: If we can find it in the Stronghold, I'll use it.

timeline.summary: Liliana and Gideon argue over whether Gideon should have told Chandra about Josu to push her to help kill Belzenlok.
timeline.quote: Because she agrees with us that it has to be done before we face Nicol Bolas again.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Teferi wave off the thallids as someone else's problem.
timeline.quote: That sounds like someone else's problem,

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crosses into Urborg at dusk, and Jhoira reports the defaced monument she calls the Fools' Tomb.
timeline.quote: Apparently the Cabal calls it the Fools' Tomb.

timeline.summary: Jhoira explains the Urborg resistance's hidden base and that her owl has arranged a meeting.
timeline.quote: And the resistance has agreed to meet with us.

timeline.summary: Jhoira and Gideon meet resistance members including the panther warrior Sayrah, and ask for Cabal clothing and a map of past battle sites.
timeline.quote: First, the clothing of a Cabal scout or fighter, someone who would be hunting Urborg for captives to take to the Stronghold's fighting pit.

timeline.summary: Liliana says she wants her pact removed and Belzenlok in pieces.
timeline.quote: I want this pact off my body. I want Belzenlok in pieces.

timeline.summary: At dawn the party sees the Stronghold in the volcano's caldera, and Gideon, Chandra, Karn and Teferi set out on foot.
timeline.quote: Belzenlok has done some rebuilding,

timeline.summary: Teferi slows time around a grotto of spirits so the party can pass unseen.
timeline.quote: With a gesture Teferi slowed time around the spirits

timeline.summary: Teferi reveals he fought Bolas long ago and lost, and says he took his spark back to join the fight; Karn says he will consider the invitation.
timeline.quote: One of the reasons I took my spark back was to come with you.

timeline.summary: Karn says he will consider joining the fight against Bolas.
timeline.quote: I'll consider your invitation.

timeline.summary: Teferi casts a time-slowing spell around Gideon and Chandra, who walk through the Stronghold's frozen guards.
timeline.quote: Then he realized Teferi and Karn had seemed to freeze in place

timeline.summary: Gideon and Chandra climb the gate and cross traps past still guards.
timeline.quote: Careful to stay close together, they climbed the gate, the broad crosspieces making a good ladder.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Chandra enter the first hall, then Chandra chains Gideon as her prisoner when the time spell ends.
timeline.quote: Chandra fastened the chains around Gideon's wrists.

timeline.summary: The time spell ends and the Stronghold fills with noise as Cabal cultists run to the defenses.
timeline.quote: Slowly, the silence around them filled like water poured into a bowl.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Chandra, delayed and without the expected diversion, are swept by a crowd into the fighting pit arena.
timeline.quote: Gideon tried to use his chains to brace her, but hands pushed him from behind and they stumbled into the arena with the crowd.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok appears in the arena to the cultists' chanting, and Whisper orders captives into the pit.
timeline.quote: Into the pit, for the glory of Belzenlok!

timeline.summary: Gideon tells Chandra to push him into the pit to buy time, and she does.
timeline.quote: Chandra shoved him, and Gideon pretended to stagger, then tumbled backward into the pit.

timeline.summary: Gideon falls into the pit, kills a maddened attacker, and takes a sword while the prisoners fight under dementia magic.
timeline.quote: That was when he realized everyone attacking him was wild-eyed with dementia magic.

timeline.summary: Gideon joins a back-to-back group led by the warrior Radha.
timeline.quote: She thrust her sword through the chest of a black-robed cultist and said, "I'm Radha."

timeline.summary: Belzenlok leaves the arena to defend the Stronghold, and Chandra searches for a way to free Gideon.
timeline.quote: Then Belzenlok stood. His voice roared, "Defend the Stronghold!"

timeline.summary: Chandra burns the chain lock on the stair mechanism and lowers the stairs so Gideon and the other prisoners can climb out.
timeline.quote: Chandra ran back to the stair mechanism, burned through the chain lock, and threw the lever.

timeline.summary: Radha throws a knife into Whisper's eye, killing her after Gideon's shield deflects her spell.
timeline.quote: Then suddenly a blade blossomed in Whisper's right eye.

timeline.summary: Radha agrees to help Gideon and Chandra after hearing the Weatherlight has been restored.
timeline.quote: "Then I'll come with you." Radha turned to the others.

timeline.summary: Chandra blasts open the treasury doors with fire.
timeline.quote: Her fire washed over it, white-hot, and burned away chains, the sigils powering the guard spells, and the door itself.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Chandra and Radha find the Blackblade in the fourth treasury vault and fight through the Stronghold's hall as the undead overwhelm the Cabal.
timeline.quote: They had found the weapon inside the fourth treasury vault, mounted on a stone plinth like a trophy.

timeline.summary: Gideon draws the Blackblade and confronts Belzenlok outside the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Gideon took a deep breath and drew the Blackblade.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok recognizes Gideon as a planeswalker of the Gatewatch and says he knows what is planned for them.
timeline.quote: You. The Gatewatch. I know what's planned for you.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok knocks Gideon down, but the Blackblade pierces his thigh and Liliana grabs the hilt.
timeline.quote: Liliana leapt forward, under Belzenlok's arm, and seized the Blackblade's hilt.

timeline.summary: Gideon gives Teferi the Gatewatch oath, while Karn and Jaya agree to fight Bolas without taking the oath.
timeline.quote: Gideon was giving Teferi the Gatewatch oath while Chandra stood by.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers leave Dominaria, but Liliana cannot planeswalk and Nicol Bolas appears to claim her.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas materialized out of the darkness, his huge scaled dragon form looming over her

timeline.summary: On the new plane Jace tells the others that Liliana never intended to come and used them, but Gideon insists she has changed.
timeline.quote: She used you, just like she uses everyone.

timeline.summary: Gideon returns to the empty Stronghold court, finds Liliana's aether trail leading away from the others, and leaves Dominaria.
timeline.quote: She had left Dominaria, but she hadn't followed him and the others.

timeline.summary: Jace, Lavinia, Gideon, Teferi, Chandra, Jaya, Ajani and Karn arrive and join the fight, and Gideon names the enemy the Eternals.
timeline.quote: Form up! The Eternals are still coming! We need to save as many people as possible!

timeline.summary: The raven-haired woman watches the planeswalkers and Rat fight, then leaves for the pyramid.
timeline.quote: her shaking her head in pity, if not disgust

timeline.summary: Gideon Jura tells the planeswalkers to split up through the city to save people and rally others, and Kaya recruits Rat and Teyo.
timeline.quote: We need to split up. Spread out through the city.

timeline.summary: Rat overhears Jace defend Vraska's act against Isperia and thinks he may be in love with her; Gideon and Jace affirm their friendship.
timeline.quote: Vraska's vengeance was well earned!

timeline.summary: Jace lays out five problems: the Beacon, the Immortal Sun, the Planar Bridge, Liliana Vess, and Bolas himself.
timeline.quote: We face a number of problems. Five to be exact.

timeline.summary: Jace identifies Liliana Vess as controlling the Eternals for Bolas and says she must be stopped forever, to Gideon's silence.
timeline.quote: Liliana Vess. She's clearly controlling the Eternals for Bolas.

timeline.summary: Gideon adds a sixth problem, protecting ordinary Ravnicans, and Zarek adds a seventh, reconstituting the Guildpact.
timeline.quote: We need to reconstitute the Guildpact by uniting all ten guilds.

timeline.summary: Gideon, encouraged by Ajani's reminder of the Oath, vows to retake Ravnica with Blackblade and the crowd gathers around him.
timeline.quote: With it, I hereby vow to take back this world. Who's with me?

timeline.summary: Gideon addresses the second summit at the Azorius Senate House and lays out a two-pronged attack to finish Bolas with Blackblade.
timeline.quote: Then I'll stab Bolas with Blackblade. And it will all be over.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch renews its Oaths, and Nissa speaks hers for the first time.
timeline.quote: Never again. Not on any world.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Jace ask Chandra to return to New Prahv and reactivate the Immortal Sun to stop Bolas bolting.
timeline.quote: We want you to return to New Prahv and turn the Immortal Sun back on.

timeline.summary: Boros airships and sky forces arrive and Gideon rides a pegasus toward Bolas.
timeline.quote: He was wielding the sword that could bring an end to all this—by bringing an end to Nicol Bolas.

timeline.summary: Liliana and the God-Eternal Oketra shoot Gideon's pegasus, and he falls behind the Citadel.
timeline.quote: Instead its six-foot length impaled his mount.
