timeline.summary: Rakdos appears as a giant flaming demon with Gideon riding his head, charging Bolas.
timeline.quote: And then I spotted Mister Jura, riding atop the demon's head.

timeline.summary: Bolas blasts Rakdos back, but Gideon leaps over and strikes; Blackblade shatters against Bolas's brow.
timeline.quote: Blackblade shattered against Nicol Bolas's invincible brow.

timeline.summary: Liliana begins to disintegrate; Gideon heals her by taking her death into himself and is destroyed.
timeline.quote: In exchange, her black death was transferring over to him.

timeline.summary: They reach the Skyclave, and Nissa, haunted by Gideon's death, asks how they will find what they need.
timeline.quote: Nahiri, how are we going to find what we need in such a vast place?

timeline.summary: Liliana asks Beledros how aetheric reincorporation could work on humans, holding a tip of Gideon's sural blade.
timeline.quote: What would it take for such methods to work on humans?

timeline.summary: Liliana begs Beledros to help give Gideon back his life.
timeline.quote: He took my death. Help me give him back his life.

timeline.summary: Liliana abandons her fruitless search for a way to revive Gideon and reflects on destiny.
timeline.quote: There wasn't a book or scroll or spell in Strixhaven that could bring Gideon back.

timeline.summary: Liliana puts away her research journals, parting from her old friend.
timeline.quote: It seems this is where we finally part, old friend.

timeline.summary: Liliana finds a name in A History of Terisiare, concludes the Raven Man is real, and resolves to destroy him for Gideon's sake.
timeline.quote: She could cleanse this tiny bit of evil from the Multiverse, for Gideon's sake.

timeline.summary: Chandra rages against the plan and compares it to Gideon's death, but the Detective calls his death atonement; Chandra hugs him and they trade farewells.
timeline.quote: "It's not like what Gideon did. It's atonement."

timeline.summary: Gideon never hesitates to enter combat to defend the innocent.
timeline.quote: never hesitates to enter combat to defend the innocent.

timeline.summary: With the help of the Gatewatch's four founders, the titans Ulamog and Kozilek are destroyed near Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: the titans Ulamog and Kozilek were destroyed near the city of Sea Gate.

pages_say.description: A warrior and planeswalker, once a bounty hunter, who tracks Chandra to Zendikar, helps defend Fort Keff, and leaves to find the Gatewatch-style organization of planeswalkers on Ravnica.
One of the five Planeswalkers whose origin story is told in Magic Origins; his home plane is Theros and he first planeswalks to Bant.
A Planeswalker and Boros ally who splits his time between fighting the Eldrazi on Zendikar and a goblin gang war on Ravnica, pushing himself to exhaustion.
A Planeswalker and Boros ally who seeks Jace's help to solve the puzzle of leylines on Zendikar.
A soldier and Planeswalker who persuaded Jace to come to Zendikar.
A Planeswalker who comes to ask Chandra for help against the Eldrazi on Zendikar.
A Planeswalker and renowned defender of Zendikar who guilts himself over arriving too late and goes to find Jori En.
A Planeswalker who rescues the last survivors at Sea Gate and leads them to the new encampment.
A Planeswalker who refuses to leave the encampment to go to the Eye.
A Planeswalker who is named Commander-General by the dying Vorik and rallies the Zendikari to retake Sea Gate.
A Planeswalker raising an army at Sea Gate whom Drana has only heard of.
The Planeswalker commanding an army at Sky Rock to retake Sea Gate.
The Planeswalker whose army Nissa will join at Sea Gate.
A planeswalker shown in Jace's illusion standing tall and inspiring the survivors.
A planeswalker seeking allies to fight the Eldrazi at Sea Gate; he is a nearly invulnerable armored warrior with glowing blades.
A planeswalker and invulnerable warrior who leads the army of Zendikar as Commander-General in the attempt to retake Sea Gate.
A planeswalker and invulnerable warrior who leads the army of Zendikar and holds Ulamog back while the hedron trap is completed.
A planeswalker who leads the Zendikari hedron operation at Sea Gate.
A planeswalker who recruits allies and leads the Zendikari army at Sea Gate.
A planeswalker and invulnerable commander who fights Ob Nixilis to protect Jace and is drowned in mud.
A planeswalker who led the Zendikari to trap Ulamog and is now missing, but appears in Tazri's vision being killed repeatedly by Kozilek.
A planeswalker whose buckler Chandra finds; he is captured by the demon and later helps defeat him.
A planeswalker whose defense at Sea Gate failed against Kozilek.
A planeswalker and warrior who proposes that the four planeswalkers stay and keep watch against threats to the Multiverse.
